lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Oregon businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Oregon is several markets in one: a large metro around Portland, university and farm towns down the Willamette Valley, resort country in the Cascades and on the coast, and ranchland to the east. We plan campaigns for the region you serve and the customers who buy there.

sections.heading: From the Willamette Valley to the high desert
paragraphs: Most Oregonians live in the Willamette Valley. Portland and its suburbs form the main business centre, with semiconductor plants in Hillsboro and sportswear and outdoor companies around Beaverton. Salem is the state capital, surrounded by farms and food processors. Eugene and Corvallis are university towns with their own technology and research firms.

East of the Cascades the climate turns dry and the pace changes. Bend has become a centre for outdoor recreation, craft brewing and people who moved there for the lifestyle and work online. Southern Oregon, around Medford and Ashland, has healthcare, orchards, wineries and a famous theatre festival. The coast lives on visitors, fishing and timber, and the far east on cattle and wheat.

sections.heading: Buyers who favour local and independent
paragraphs: Oregon customers pay attention to who they buy from. Independent ownership, local sourcing, environmental practice and fair treatment of staff influence choices here more than in most states, and people are quick to notice claims that are not backed up. Marketing works best when it shows the real business: the owners, the workshop, the suppliers, the reasons behind a price.
Oregon also has no state sales tax. Shoppers come across the Columbia River from Washington for large purchases, and retailers near the border can speak directly to that.
bullets: About pages and product stories written with specifics, not slogans.
Photography and video of the actual place, people and process.
Reviews answered in a human voice.
Clear statements on sourcing or sustainability only where you can support them.
Local search set up for each town you serve, since Oregonians search by community.

sections.heading: Seasons, visitors and smoke
paragraphs: West of the mountains, winters are grey and wet and summers dry and bright, and the calendar follows. Roofing, gutter, drainage and moss removal firms take calls through the rainy months. Summer is the season for the coast, the Columbia Gorge, Crater Lake, wine country and river trips, while Mount Hood and Mount Bachelor bring skiers in winter.

Late summer now often brings wildfire smoke, which can cancel outdoor bookings at short notice and lift demand for air filtration and indoor activities. Tourism businesses need flexible campaigns and clear cancellation information, and they should build search visibility well ahead of the season, because trips are researched weeks before travel.

sections.heading: Makers, growers and brands that ship
paragraphs: Oregon produces a great many products with a strong sense of origin: Willamette Valley wines, craft beer and cider, coffee, hazelnuts, berries, outdoor gear, bicycles, knives, furniture. Many of these companies sell well beyond the state through their own online stores. For them we work on stores that load fast and convert, product photography, search content that answers what buyers ask, and paid campaigns managed against margin.

cards.heading: Oregon sectors we plan campaigns for

items.title: Wineries, breweries and food producers
items.text: Tasting room visits, club memberships and online orders grow with good listings, email and seasonal campaigns.

items.title: Outdoor and apparel brands
items.text: Gear makers need online stores, UGC and product video, and ads that reach buyers nationally.

items.title: Tourism and lodging
items.text: Coast, Gorge and Central Oregon operators depend on search visibility and booking pages ahead of each season.

items.title: Technology suppliers
items.text: Firms serving the chip plants and software companies west of Portland need precise capability pages and targeted outreach.

items.title: Home services
items.text: Roofing, drainage, heating and remodelling firms compete in local map results town by town.

items.title: Health and wellness
items.text: Clinics and practitioners build trust with clear service pages, reviews and carefully worded ads.

presence: TDM works with Oregon businesses remotely. We have no office in Oregon. Meetings are held by video call, and strategy, creative work and reporting are shared online.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an Oregon office?
faqs.a: No. We work with businesses in Oregon remotely, with scheduled video calls and written reports.

faqs.q: How is marketing in Bend different from Portland?
faqs.a: Bend is a smaller market shaped by recreation, tourism and new residents, with strong seasonal swings in summer and ski season. Portland is a large metro with many distinct neighbourhoods and suburbs. Each needs its own keywords, timing and creative.

faqs.q: Can you help an Oregon winery or brewery sell online?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build or improve the store, set up search and email, and run ads within the platform rules for alcohol. Shipping limits vary by state, so campaigns are targeted only where you can deliver.

faqs.q: How should tourism businesses plan for wildfire season?
faqs.a: Keep cancellation and rebooking terms easy to find, be ready to pause or shift ads when conditions change, and promote alternatives such as indoor experiences or later dates.

faqs.q: What does digital marketing cost in Oregon?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: the services you need and the markets you want to reach. We quote after a free consultation.
